experience.title: Psychological Counselor | Glowe Counseling Platform
details: Provide individual counseling for anxiety, depression, sleep difficulties, academic stress, relationships, and cross-cultural adjustment.
Cumulative experience across university and private-practice settings exceeds 1,500 counseling hours, with more than 250 hours of clinical supervision.
Receive ongoing supervision and case consultation.

experience.title: Volunteer Mental Health Helpline Counselor | Tsinghua University
details: Provide emotional support and crisis intervention through the Wellbeing Public Welfare Hotline.
Training includes trauma-informed listening, suicide risk assessment, and active presence.

experience.title: Volunteer Group Facilitator | Independent Community Program
details: Designed and facilitated Rooted & Blooming, a free self-exploration group for master’s and doctoral students.
Integrated mindfulness, botanical collage, photo-based reflection, OH cards, guided sharing, and life-review exercises.
Focused on academic stress, cross-cultural adjustment, relationships, and self-worth within a psychologically safe group setting.

experience.title: Clinical Psychology Consultant | Tsinghua University
details: Contributed clinical expertise to AI-assisted counseling and human–computer interaction research, including the AICo project.
Developed structured decision frameworks linking presenting concerns, assessment, psychotherapy strategies, and follow-up support.

experience.title: Trainee Psychotherapist | Guangzhou Medical University
details: Rotated through psychosomatic medicine outpatient and inpatient units.
Participated in interdisciplinary case meetings and treatment planning; observed and assisted with integrated psychotherapy and pharmacotherapy cases.

experience.title: Mental Health Counselor | Guangzhou College of Commerce
details: Provided individual counseling, assessment, and crisis support, including intervention with more than 20 high-risk cases.
Accumulated more than 500 individual counseling hours at the university counseling center.
Trained peer-support volunteers and advised the student mental health association.
Designed mindfulness and photo-diary programs; a photo-based group program received First Prize in a Guangdong Province college mental health competition.
